entities.name: Leshrac
entities.description: A planeswalker who escaped Shandalar, was imprisoned in an oubliette in Estark, and is now an incorporeal shade.

entities.name: Arlen
entities.description: A Prodigal Sorcerer from the Institute of Arcane Study investigating why Estark natives are gifted in magic; killed by Leshrac's hand.

entities.name: Institute of Arcane Study
entities.description: The institute on Dominaria that Arlen left.

entities.name: Estark
entities.description: A city whose natives are gifted in magic thanks to Leshrac's excess energy.

entities.name: Ravidel
entities.description: A figure who forced Leshrac to spend all his mana in a duel and plans the Mox Beacon.

entities.name: Taysir
entities.description: A figure who put Leshrac in an oubliette to use his life energy to re-enter Rabiah.

entities.name: Oubliette
entities.description: The prison in which Leshrac is trapped.

entities.name: Rabiah
entities.description: A place Taysir sought to re-enter with Leshrac's life energy.

entities.name: Kristina of the Woods
entities.description: A woman who refused Taysir's request to give her energy and be his mortal wife on Rabiah.

entities.name: Chromium Rhuell
entities.description: A dragon Leshrac used to enter Shandalar.

entities.name: Ulgrotha
entities.description: The place where Taysir spent centuries with the Anaba.

entities.name: Anaba
entities.description: A people with whom Taysir spent centuries.

entities.name: Mox Beacon
entities.description: Ravidel's planned device that Leshrac hopes to use to escape.

events.summary: In a duel in Estark, Ravidel forces Leshrac to spend all his mana on counterspells, and Taysir puts him into an Oubliette.
events.quote: Taysir put him into an Oubliette

events.summary: Taysir tells Leshrac he will use his life energy to re-enter Rabiah, having been refused by Kristina of the Woods.
events.quote: Taysir tells Leshrac of his plan to use his life energy to re-enter Rabiah

events.summary: As Ravidel and Taysir drain him, Leshrac casts a spell that saves his life; the portal fails and he remains trapped as an incorporeal shade, his excess energy flowing into the people of Estark.
events.quote: His excess energy then flows into the people of Estark

events.summary: Taysir visits Leshrac after his time on Ulgrotha, finds him full of hate, and leaves him imprisoned.
events.quote: Taysir feels justified in keeping him locked up and leaves him to his misery.

events.summary: Leshrac manifests his hand and cuts Arlen's throat, confident he will soon escape using Ravidel's Mox Beacon.
events.quote: cuts the poor wizard's throat, just because he can

relations.note: cut his throat with a manifested hand
